properties.text: A Kremlin-affiliated Russian milblogger claimed on June 9 that Ukrainian forces recently counterattacked near Chasiv Yar and maintain control over Podilske and Mykolaivka (both west of Chasiv Yar).[15] Russian forces are also struggling to advance toward Slovyansk on the northern flank of the Fortress Belt.
[63] Russian forces continued offensive operations in the Pokrovsk and Novopavlivka directions on June 10 but did not advance.

Geolocated footage published on June 10 confirms the strikes against the port in Mariupol.[68] Russian Supporting Effort: Southern Axis Russian objective: Maintain frontline positions, secure rear areas against Ukrainian strikes, and advance within tube artillery range of Zaporizhzhia City Russian forces continued offensive operations in the Hulyaipole direction on June 9 and 10 but did not advance.

Geolocated footage published on June 8 indicates that Ukrainian forces advanced north of Lobkove (southwest of Orikhiv).[70] Russian forces attacked near southwest of Kherson City near Bilohrudyi Island on June 10 but did not advance.

The Ukrainian General Staff reported on June 9 that Ukrainian forces struck a Russian material and technical warehouse near Fedorivka (southeast of Slovyansk) on June 8 or the night of June 8 to 9.[42] Ukrainian forces recently advanced in the Kostyantynivka-Druzhkivka tactical area as Russian forces infiltrated into Kostyantynivka itself.
